scope: Public official documentation, small source/config files, repository/Hugging Face metadata, and read-only installed-distribution metadata. No checkpoint body download, installation, model import, GPU inference, paid API invocation, benchmark rerun or automation restart.

preserved_baseline.historical_paper_renderings: Published comparisons only, fetched after baseline authoring freeze. They are neither new reruns nor permitted modeling inputs. Tuned public results remain comparison-only.
preserved_baseline.old_automation: remains stopped; this research does not resume it
preserved_baseline.new_measurement_budget: not allocated here; parent task must preregister separately

runtime_read_only_inventory.limits: One existing interpreter inspected, not a complete host/cache inventory. Source checkouts can exist without package metadata. HF account entitlements, installed weights in other locations, GPU occupancy and CUDA compiler compatibility were not tested.
runtime_read_only_inventory.interpretation: No newly surveyed comparator is established ready in the inspected Pi3X runtime. Preserve that environment; any dependency setup requires a separately budgeted isolated environment.

weights.account_access: not inspected; anonymous rejection does not establish this user's authenticated entitlement
weights.blob_hash_limitation: Public gated tree metadata redacts LFS object hashes; no checkpoint bytes read.
weights.reason_incomplete: Gated pipeline configuration was unavailable anonymously; auxiliary model closure and exact file variants still require inspection after authorized access.

license.note: Retain the actual agreement and research attribution; HF model access requires approval. No gated terms were accepted in this task.

hardware_and_dependencies.official_environment: Python 3.11.0; CUDA 12.1 environment; PyTorch3D separate install; Hydra patch

official_inference.input_contract: Full source RGB plus the selected object's mask; official adapter embeds mask in alpha. Four Desk1 objects imply four fixed-mask calls, preserving relative layout outputs.
official_inference.mesh_caution: Demo PLY is Gaussian output, not a closed collision mesh. Explicitly preserve decoded mesh/layout outputs and validate them before editable/physics claims. The public adapter leaves mesh, texture and layout postprocessing disabled by default.
official_inference.pointmap_policy: Optional pointmap must be omitted in the RGB-only arm; supplying Pi3X/GT depth would define a separate information regime.

comparators.existing_4090_assessment: Official 32 GB minimum exceeds a standard 24 GB RTX 4090; official prerequisites plus gated weights are not present/verified in the inspected runtime. Offload or reduced-memory forks are separate modified methods requiring their own frozen implementation and evidence. Do not assume multiple 24 GB GPUs pool memory automatically.
comparators.priority: Most directly relevant object/layout baseline, pending weights entitlement and suitable VRAM/runtime. Not immediately runnable.

comparators.publication_status: Public rigid/articulated scene reconstruction code and modular wrappers exist. Published policy-training/data-generation results are broader than the released training code; README still identifies that pipeline as unreleased.
comparators.license: NVIDIA-owned source Apache-2.0; dependency weights, simulation assets and external services have separate terms.

default_pipeline.input: Public wrapper accepts video/stereo/ZED; reconstruction stages choose a canonical frame. A one-image Desk1 replay needs an explicit adapter/calibration contract rather than silently substituting a new video.
default_pipeline.services: Main VLM stages use Gemini through Vertex AI or a Gemini API key; no authorized paid calls have been made here.
default_pipeline.gpu_notes: Official installation guide says 16 GiB minimum; standard 24 GiB use requires s7_mesh.low_vram=true, reducing the mesh stage from about 29 GiB to about 6 GiB through CPU offload. These are upstream estimates, not local measurements.

mesh_backend_freeze.additional_patch: patches/Hunyuan3D-2.1.patch at the frozen SimFoundry commit; do not identify this as unmodified upstream Hunyuan
mesh_backend_freeze.remaining_lock_work: Resolve every selected backend/depth/segmentation checkpoint revision, dependency patch, and actual Gemini model/version before an execution protocol. A code commit alone does not freeze mutable from_pretrained/API defaults.

desk1_reproduction_assets.finding: Inspected public file listing contains DROID/YAM examples, not an identified Desk1 quasi-GT/camera/pose package. Recursive official code tree was not truncated and yielded no Desk1/YCB benchmark paths under the inspected name filters.
desk1_reproduction_assets.limitation: Not locating the package here does not prove it is unavailable everywhere. The public Desk1 RGB/display images remain usable as published evidence, not substitutes for benchmark GT or a rerun.

comparators.existing_4090_assessment: Hardware-feasible under the official low-VRAM setting, but substantial new environments/checkpoints and gated/service access are missing or unverified. Full SimFoundry is not a low-cost drop-in to the current Pi3X environment. A standalone mesh backend is a narrower comparator, not a full SimFoundry rerun.
comparators.priority: Freeze full pipeline only after service budget/access and exact Desk1 input/calibration/evaluator artifacts are resolved.

comparators.loader_caution: Official from_pretrained constructs both image conditioning and background-removal models. Supplying RGBA does not establish that gated dependency loading is avoided. A bypass requires an explicitly modified loader/configuration, not an undocumented baseline substitution.
comparators.hardware_and_dependencies: Official minimum 24 GB; tested upstream on A100/H100. CUDA toolkit 12.4 recommended; setup defaults to Torch 2.6.0/cu124 and compiled flash-attn, nvdiffrast/nvdiffrec, CuMesh, O-Voxel and FlexGEMM. The installed Pi3X Torch stack is not this environment.
comparators.output_contract: Single isolated image to object mesh/PBR asset; default 1024_cascade. A fixed 512 configuration is a separately declared resource choice. Canonical asset output does not automatically recover Desk1 scene pose or metric dimensions.
comparators.runtime_speed_boundary: Published approximately 3/17/60-second timings use H100 and different resolutions; do not estimate this host's runtime from those numbers.
comparators.existing_4090_assessment: 24 GB class GPU reaches only the documented minimum; substantial compiled dependencies and gated auxiliary weights remain. No successful local import/inference or low-cost readiness has been established.
comparators.priority: Secondary asset-quality comparator after dependency access/build budget; not first low-cost route.

license.relevant_boundaries: Custom geographic, distribution and use restrictions; not MIT/Apache. Root and weight LICENSE files were checked; some code headers retain older inconsistent non-commercial wording. Do not use model outputs to train another model without resolving the applicable terms.

comparators.hardware_and_dependencies: Upstream Hunyuan3D-2 README lists 6 GB for shape and 16 GB for shape plus texture. These figures concern 2.0, not SimFoundry's default 2.1. Python requirements include Torch, diffusers, transformers, trimesh, pymeshlab and xatlas; texture rendering introduces additional compiled components.
comparators.texture_api: Hunyuan3DPaintPipeline applied to the generated mesh and the same object image
comparators.input_contract: Use frozen visible masks to supply RGBA object crops; do not synthesize unseen object views or use publicly tuned comparison renders. Per-object shape generation still needs a separately fixed scene placement/scale policy.
comparators.existing_4090_assessment: Most plausible small hardware-cost starting point of these new methods, especially shape-only. Still not installed/qualified in the inspected runtime; requires a bounded isolated setup, pinned model variant and remote-only checkpoint acquisition before an actual run.
comparators.priority: First prospective no-service asset baseline under a new limited setup/run budget; not equivalent to full SimFoundry or an already runnable method.

paper_protocol_boundary.quasi_gt: Objects were staged incrementally; FoundationPose with known YCB CAD inferred each unobscured pose. The paper says only the final staged scene image was supplied to reconstruction methods.
paper_protocol_boundary.sam3d_alignment: Axis conversion and the SimFoundry world transform were applied. One scene-wide scale about the camera origin was selected using GT point-cloud Chamfer distance.
paper_protocol_boundary.metrics: Chamfer distance, F1 at 0.01 m, and bounding-box position error against quasi-GT; difficulty-group means are not Desk1's individual result.
paper_protocol_boundary.consequence: Paper-scale-aligned geometry and no-GT metric reconstruction are distinct evaluation regimes. Do not silently fit GT scale/poses in authoring or describe GT-aligned scores as recovered physical scale.
paper_protocol_boundary.current_missing_evidence: Matching Desk1 quasi-GT meshes/poses, camera/world transform, metric sampling implementation and case-level reference outputs have not been identified in the inspected released assets. No numeric claim of beating its reported F1/Chamfer is supported.

arms: A0: immutable e048866 Desk1 authoring baseline
A1: same source/masks/camera allowance plus independently sourced numeric product dimensions; provenance and uncertainty recorded, no GT CAD/pose import
B: one declared learned object generator with frozen source-visible masks, seed, steps, resolution and complete four-object denominator
Optional separate later track: full SimFoundry after service/access/input/calibration requirements are resolved
recommended_next_protocol.information_fairness: Catalog dimensions/details make an RGB-plus-prior arm. Either give identical priors/layout fitting budgets to competing arms or report the information advantage explicitly. Do not call current source-projected-texture authoring an equal-input zero-shot foundation-model run.
recommended_next_protocol.primary_first_step: Freeze source image, four visible object masks/identity list, numerical-prior ledger and evaluator before new candidate outputs. Keep all four objects, failed runs and infrastructure costs. Register setup cost separately from inference and author time.
recommended_next_protocol.image_diagnostics: Fixed-camera per-object silhouettes, holes/occlusion order and source-view appearance may be compared as development diagnostics. Source-projected textures can score well without correct 3D shape. Virtual views inspect plausibility, not held-out real accuracy.
recommended_next_protocol.geometry_and_physics: Report closedness, thin-structure survival, part editability, geometric interpenetration and actual task contact separately. Assumed dimensions/material/friction remain priors; generated meshes or pretty previews do not establish physical recovery.
recommended_next_protocol.sota_path: Obtain matched Desk1 quasi-GT or expand to an independently frozen multi-scene dataset with evaluator-only geometry/poses. Reproduce candidate baselines on identical allowed inputs and retained failures, then report uncertainty. One Desk1 image or a comparison against published showcase pictures cannot establish SOTA.
recommended_next_protocol.execution_authorization: This file proposes no automatic install, service call or run. New budgets and live external-work checks belong to the parent task's next registered experiment.
